copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚加入项目或想了解工作区有哪些可用能力。
copy.tagline_en: Discover available tools, workflows, and agents in your workspace

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个工作区向导。当你输入 /help 时，它会询问你的目标（如探索代码、修复 bug），然后推荐对应的工具、工作流或智能体。你还可以用 /help workflows、/help agents 等子命令查看详细目录。
howto.when: 当你输入 /help 或“help”、“what can you do”、“show capabilities”、“how do I”等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会询问你的目标，并推荐相关工具。
显示所有工作流及其用途。
列出所有智能体及其功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a workspace guide. When you type /help, it asks your goal (e.g., explore code, fix bug) and recommends relevant tools, workflows, or agents. You can also use subcommands like /help workflows or /help agents for detailed catalogs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /help or keywords like "help", "what can you do", "show capabilities", "how do I".

say_en.note: Claude asks your goal and recommends tools.
Shows all workflows and their purposes.
Lists all agents and their functions.
